review.note: Extracted as text from the old lesson, then reviewed against the verified dataset. A line with "review" set is held (not shown) until a teacher resolves it. Dropped: the five Tajweed rules, the Tajweed quiz question and the two Tajweed games (Tajweed comes only from the reviewed dataset), the audio URLs, and every hand-typed Quran string (replaced by positions). Also dropped: the quiz question "which ayah comes after la a'budu ma ta'budun?", because its question is typed Quran and two of its three options (ayat 3 and 5) are the same text. The complete-the-ayah words are the answers of the old "missing word" game; its hand-typed distractors (none of them words of this surah) are gone, as the game draws its options from these words. The old quiz had no categories; they were assigned here. Each lesson learned is its old title and description joined; the lessons' "how do we apply it" lines are the reflection's ideas, under the old two reflection questions joined. Not carried (no field or no such game in the engine): the "Makki" type, the revelation story and the hadith of the intro card, the ayah-ordering, next-ayah, memory, build-the-ayah and meaning games, and the intro quiz.

intro.text: سورة الكافرون هي سورة مكية نزلت على النبي ﷺ في مكة المكرمة. تتحدث عن التوحيد وعبادة الله وحده.

tafsir.text: يقول الله لنبيه محمد ﷺ: قل يا محمد لهؤلاء الذين لا يؤمنون بالله
أنا لا أعبد الأصنام التي تعبدونها أبداً
وأنتم لن تعبدوا الله الذي أعبده
tafsir.review: Says "you will never worship Allah". Common tafsir reads this as said to particular Quraysh leaders who died in disbelief, or as "you are not worshippers of what I worship"; as written a child may take it to mean that no non-Muslim can ever believe. Teacher to confirm the wording.

tafsir.text: ولن أعبد أبداً ما تعبدون من أصنام
وأنتم لن تعبدوا الله الذي أعبده وحده
tafsir.review: Says "you will never worship Allah". Common tafsir reads this as said to particular Quraysh leaders who died in disbelief, or as "you are not worshippers of what I worship"; as written a child may take it to mean that no non-Muslim can ever believe. Teacher to confirm the wording.

tafsir.text: لكم دينكم الذي اخترتموه ولي ديني الإسلام، دين الله الحق

words.review: PHRASE: the old entry is "la a'budu" (2:1-2); this points at a'budu (2:2) and the meaning carries the negation; the engine shows one word. Teacher to confirm it reads right.
PHRASE: the old entry is "ma ta'budun" (2:3-4); this points at ta'budun (2:4); the engine shows one word. Teacher to confirm it reads right.
PHRASE: the old entry is "ma a'budu" (3:4-5, repeated as 5:4-5); this points at a'budu (3:5); the engine shows one word. Teacher to confirm it reads right.
PHRASE: the old entry is "ma 'abadtum" (4:4-5); this points at 'abadtum (4:5); the engine shows one word. Teacher to confirm it reads right.

quiz.question: ما الدرس الأهم من سورة الكافرون؟
أكمل الآية
quiz.review: CHANGED: the old options were two-word phrases (ma 'abadtum / ma ta'budun / ma a'budu). The prompt now shows four words, up to "ma", and the options are the second words ('abadtum / ta'budun / a'budu). Teacher to confirm.

lessons.text: عبادة الله وحده: نعبد الله وحده ولا نعبد غيره
الثبات على الحق: نبقى على ديننا ولا نتركه أبداً
احترام الآخرين: نحترم الجميع حتى لو كانوا مختلفين عنا
lessons.review: Presents the surah as teaching respect for people who differ. Common tafsir reads "lakum dinukum wa liya din" as a disavowal of their worship (bara'a), not approval of it. Good manners are right, but teacher to decide whether this lesson belongs to this surah and how to word it.

lessons.text: الصدق والأمانة: نقول الحق دائماً كما فعل النبي ﷺ
lessons.review: Truthfulness is not a theme of this surah. Teacher to decide whether to keep it here.

lessons.text: حب الله ورسوله: نحب الله ونحب النبي محمد ﷺ

reflection.question: ما أجمل شيء تعلمته من سورة الكافرون؟ كيف يمكن أن نطبق ما تعلمناه في حياتنا؟
ideas: نصلي لله وحده ونشكره على كل النعم
نحافظ على صلاتنا حتى لو لم يصلِّ أصدقاؤنا
نكون لطفاء مع كل الناس ونعاملهم بأدب
نقرأ القرآن كل يوم ونتعلم سيرة النبي ﷺ

didYouKnow.text: سورة الكافرون تسمى أيضاً سورة المقشقشة لأنها تبرئ من الشرك
سورة الكافرون هي السورة رقم 109 في القرآن الكريم
كان النبي ﷺ يقرأ سورة الكافرون قبل النوم
didYouKnow.review: The known hadith (Nawfal al-Ashja'i, in Abu Dawud and al-Tirmidhi) is the Prophet telling a companion to recite it before sleeping, not a report that he himself did. Teacher to reword.

didYouKnow.text: قراءة القرآن كل يوم تجعلنا أقرب إلى الله
كل حرف نقرأه من القرآن لنا به حسنة والحسنة بعشر أمثالها
سورة الكافرون نزلت في مكة المكرمة
معنى الكافرون: الذين لا يؤمنون بالله
كلمة 'دين' تعني الطريقة التي نعبد بها الله
